findings.action: Directory status entries are hashed only as a constant dir marker. A nested repository or submodule can remain dirty with the same parent porcelain status across edits or child commits, while files read by BuildIndexFederatedMaterialIn change. Unless that child is separately enumerated as an authorized root, the key remains unchanged and the old material digest is reused. Recurse through relevant repository state or decline retention for directory entries whose contents are not covered.

A cache hit returns a digest without replaying the material's input observations into the current governance read view. The replacement key uses gitOutputIn and native os reads outside that view. Consequently, material-only dependencies are absent from the current operation's observation closure and final audit; changes after the lookup can escape detection. A miss can also retain a digest built from previously captured Files under a key read from newer native state. Preserve and validate the input closure when reusing material, and retain only a digest proven to correspond to its key.

The status command omits ignored files, but ListSpecs and the other material readers do not exclude them. Editing an ignored dependency spec can change the actual material without changing HEAD, status or the key. The spec's technical-risk assumption that material inputs are versioned is neither enforced nor established by the focused tests. Cover these inputs or refuse retention when their completeness cannot be proven.

The default branch reads any status-listed filesystem object that is neither a directory nor a symlink, with no regular-file check, byte budget or cancellation. An untracked FIFO blocks os.ReadFile awaiting a writer, and a large unrelated file can exhaust memory. These objects need not be inputs to the material itself. Decline caching for special files and bound reads of regular files.

The 4096-path limit is checked only after repositoryState has captured the complete status, split it, and read and hashed every listed file. An over-limit repository therefore incurs all supposedly bounded key work before falling back to another material build. Enforce the remaining path budget during status processing before reading file contents, and bound retained status output.
